title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
description:
Given the head of a sorted linked list, delete all duplicates such that each element appears only once . Return the linked list sorted as well . 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/01/04/list1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,1,2]

Output:
 [1,2]
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2021/01/04/list2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 head = [1,1,2,3,3]

Output:
 [1,2,3]
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 300] . 
 
 -100 <= Node.val <= 100 
 
 The list is guaranteed to be sorted in ascending order.
approach_summary: Rewire node links while preserving ownership and pointer invariants.
